blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang is unaware of any agreement reached between first lady Liza Araneta-Marcos and the head of transport group Manibela, even as the group decided to cut short its planned transport strike following their meeting. In a briefing on Wednesday, Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said she had yet to speak with the first lady about the details of her conversation with Manibela Chair Mar Valbuena, who responded positively to the first lady’s appeal to reconsider the strike. Castro said Manibela’s negotiations could also be conducted with government agencies involved in the transport sector, including the Department of Transportation […]...
